{{Quote|I recently 'obtained' a large shipment of these units from an Imperial supply depot. Anybody interested in purchasing some or all of these droids can contact me on Sullust.|Barazzi|<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>}}
'''Barazzi''' was a [[Thief/Legends|thief]] who "acquired" a shipment of [[LE-series repair droid]]s from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[supply depot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Barazzi directed interested parties to contact them on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].
